metric_definitions.primary: Q uses 20001 top-level scene/reference position states; SO3 is geodesic RMSE to top-level scene/reference-derived task attitude; inner is geodesic RMSE over 20000 transitions.
metric_definitions.axis_note: wrapped Euler roll/pitch/yaw values are coordinate-axis errors, not SO(3) components and do not replace SO(3).
metric_definitions.peaks: per-scene maxima of position norm, task SO3, inner SO3, and absolute wrapped Euler axes, full and by phase.
metric_definitions.score_source: Reuses the reviewed cosine score() helper; candidate and comparison raw are checked as 20001 states / 20000 transitions.

interpretation_limit: Read-only paired scoring of completed audited runs; not a stability proof and does not authorize additional flights.
